programme.title: Tutankhamun: Life, Death and Legacy
programme.desc: Dan meets the mummies of Tutankhamun's parents at the Egyptian Museum in Cairo, and discovers that they were actually brother and sister. CT scans reveal how this incestuous relationship could have been responsible for Tutankhamun's poor health. Raksha heads underground to a rare tomb excavation in the Valley of the Kings which has never been seen before on television.

programme.title: Tutankhamun: Life, Death and Legacy
programme.desc: Picking up the story in 1323BC, the pharaoh sustains the injury that would eventually kill him. On a scan of Tutankhamun's skeleton, Dan sees a break to his thigh bone which could have been a battle injury. John visits Howard Carter's house and probes the 1920s craze of `Tutmania', when the Western world went crazy for all things Egyptian.

programme.title: Tutankhamun: Life, Death and Legacy
programme.desc: Dan discovers a series of curious anomalies in Tutankhamun's burial, and spots that the faces on his coffins and canopic jars do not match that of the famous golden mask. Raksha looks at Seti's tomb, which shows how low quality and hurried Tutankhamun's was in comparison. John learns how to dance like an Egyptian at a funeral, and investigates the truth of the `Curse of Tutankhamun'.

programme.title: Treasures of Ancient Egypt
programme.desc: Alastair Sooke tells the story of Ancient Egyptian art and how it reflected the civilisation's religion, through thirty extraordinary masterpieces.

programme.title: Treasures of Ancient Egypt
programme.desc: Alastair Sooke explores the sumptuous treasures of the Golden Age of Egyptian art, starting with troubling psychological portraits of tyrant king Senwosret III, and ending with the golden mask of boy-king Tutankhamun.

programme.title: Ice Age Giants
programme.desc: Journey back 40,000 years and discover the great beasts of the Ice Age with Professor Alice Roberts. Alice's Ice Age odyssey begins in the land of the Sabre-tooth, North America, a continent that was half-covered by ice, up to two miles thick. Yet, it also boasts the most impressive cast of Ice Age Giants in the world.

programme.title: Ice Age Giants
programme.desc: Alice ventures to the parts of the Northern Hemisphere, hit the hardest by the cold - Europe and Siberia. High in the mountains of Transylvania, a cave sealed for thousands of years reveals grisly evidence for a fight to the death between two starving giants, a cave bear and a cave lion. Yet Alice discovers that for woolly rhinos and woolly mammoths, the Ice Age created a bounty.

programme.title: Ice Age Giants
programme.desc: Even after thousands of years of ice crushing the Northern Hemisphere and temperatures of 20 degrees lower than those of today, many of the great giants of the Ice Age still walked the earth. It was only when the world had warmed up again that mammoths, woolly rhinos, sabre-toothed cats and giant ground sloths finally became extinct. programme.title: Horizon
programme.desc: Scientists investigate the meteorite impact responsible for the extinction of dinosaurs. According to a theory, the event was triggered by a comet hitting the present-day Gulf of Mexico.

programme.title: Lost Cities of The Ancients
programme.desc: A journey to discover the legendary lost city of Piramesse, a magnificent ancient capital built 3,000 years ago by the Egyptian pharaoh Ramesses the Great. When it was finally rediscovered by early archaeologists, it opened up a bizarre puzzle because it was in the wrong place.

programme.title: Lost Cities of The Ancients
programme.desc: In the Lambayeque valley in northern Peru lies a strange lost world, the forgotten ruins of 250 mysterious pyramids, including some of the biggest on the planet, colossal structures made out of mud bricks.

programme.title: Lost Cities of The Ancients
programme.desc: This is the story of the formidable Hittites and their long-lost capital, Hattusha, which has recently been rediscovered. Buried in this lost city is one of the greatest libraries of the ancient world, and all the secrets of this mysterious civilisation were written in two codes - one a unique form of hieroglyphs with which we can recreate the lost world of the Hittites.

programme.title: Archaeology: A Secret History
programme.desc: Archaeologist Richard Miles presents a series charting the history of the breakthroughs and watersheds in our long quest to understand our ancient past. He begins by going back 2,000 years to explore how archaeology began by trying to prove a biblical truth - a quest that soon got archaeologists into dangerous water.

programme.title: Archaeology: A Secret History
programme.desc: Archaeologist Richard Miles shows how discoveries in the 18th and 19th centuries overturned ideas of when and where civilisation began, as empires competed to 'own' the past.

programme.title: Archaeology: A Secret History
programme.desc: Richard Miles shows how 20th-century attention turned from civilisation and kings to the search for the common man against a background of science and competing political ideologies.

programme.title: Secrets of the Pyramids
programme.desc: Exploring fresh archaeological excavations that shed new light on the lives of those who worked tirelessly on the pyramids.

programme.title: Walking with Monsters: Life Before Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Part 1/3. As life starts evolving in the oceans, our bizarre earliest ancestors battle against 3m long sea scorpions and giant carnivorous fish. Their ability to survive will determine the shape of life on Earth and whether humans will exist at all. As our amphibian ancestors struggle onto land the monsters they face are even more deadly.

programme.title: Walking with Beasts
programme.desc: Special effects-filled documentary beginning 49 million years ago. The world is heavily forested and birds rule the planet, preying on small mammals. Whales have not yet evolved, and their ancestors walk on the land.

programme.title: Walking with Beasts
programme.desc: A pregnant basilosaurus, an 18-metre, carnivorous whale which lives in the Tethys Sea, is forced to kill the young of a smaller whale to ensure the survival of her unborn calf.

programme.title: Walking with Beasts
programme.desc: Going back 25 million years to the time of the indricothere, which was the largest mammal ever to live on dry land, being seven metres high and weighing 15 tons! The only threat to an adult would have been the hyaenodon which was the size of a rhino and had jaws that could crush a rock.

programme.title: Walking with Beasts
programme.desc: The beginnings of mankind can be traced back 3.2 million years to Ethiopia and the advent of Australopithecus, a type of ape which, like humans, was bipedal. These early members of the human family faced many dangers, including the sabre-toothed cat, malaria, and the 14-tonne delnotherium.

programme.title: Science of Walking With Beasts
programme.desc: This episode explains how the 120-million-year reign of the dinosaurs ended when mammals became the fastest and fiercest creatures on the planet.

programme.title: Science of Walking With Beasts
programme.desc: A look at the science that has proved Darwin's idea that intelligent, sophisticated humans have an ancestral connection with the ape.

programme.title: Walking With Cavemen
programme.desc: The lives of cavemen were nasty, brutish and short, but somehow they evolved over 3.5 million years into Homo sapiens.

programme.title: Walking With Cavemen
programme.desc: Two very different species compete for survival in Africa 2,000,000 years ago.

programme.title: Walking with Monsters: Life Before Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Part 1/3. As life starts evolving in the oceans, our bizarre earliest ancestors battle against 3m long sea scorpions and giant carnivorous fish. Their ability to survive will determine the shape of life on Earth and whether humans will exist at all. As our amphibian ancestors struggle onto land the monsters they face are even more deadly.

programme.title: Walking with Monsters: Life Before Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Part 2/3. Millions of years before the dinosaurs, a world full of giant sabretooth reptiles and huge armoured herbivores was obliterated when global temperatures soared and vast deserts blanketed the land. As the environment recovered, populations of one species of tough reptile exploded until it alone dominated the planet, but its reign was short-lived.

programme.title: Walking with Monsters: Life Before Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Part 3/3. The struggle for survival moves onto land in the shape of early reptiles such as Petrolacosaurus. In the Carboniferous swamps, insects and arthropods have taken over and grown into giants, from the giant spider Mesothelae to millipede-like monsters. As the swamps dry up, the world becomes dominated by the first ever giant reptiles - the huge, sail-backed Edaphosaurus.

programme.title: Walking with Dinosaurs
programme.desc: The life of the first reptilian carnivores on Earth, told through computer animation.

programme.title: Walking with Dinosaurs
programme.desc: This programme travels 152 million years into the past to a planet dominated by mighty, long-necked sauropods - the largest animals ever to walk the earth. There were no birds, flowers or grass, and the land was carpeted by fern prairies and coniferous forests.

programme.title: Walking with Dinosaurs
programme.desc: A look at the world as it was 149 million years ago - in the late Jurassic Period. The old continents have broken up and much of the land is under water. Huge shallow seas have supported a revolution in marine life.

programme.title: Walking with Dinosaurs
programme.desc: A mind-expanding trip back through time to look at how the skies of 127 million years ago were dominated by huge flying reptiles, some as large as aeroplanes. The programme also follows the extraordinary journey of the pterosaur, which flew for thousands of miles in order to reach its breeding site. Narrated by Kenneth Branagh.

programme.title: Walking with Dinosaurs
programme.desc: This programme looks at the Cretaceous period, 106 million years ago. Volcanic activity forces the continents apart, and dinosaurs diversify into a range of species to cope with environmental extremes. The landmass that will become Australia and Antarctica is in sunlight for half of the year, and in frozen darkness for the rest.

programme.title: Walking with Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Looking at the closing chapters of the Cretaceous period, 65 million years ago, when the world is poisoned by massive volcanic activity. Among the fields of burning ash, the dinosaurs struggle for survival, oblivious to the Earth's impending collision with a giant comet.

programme.title: Monsters We Met
programme.desc: In Australia 65,000 years ago, the first human explorers face a land populated with giant lizards, killer rhino-like creatures and deadly birds.

programme.title: Monsters We Met

programme.title: La robe de ma vie
programme.desc: Suivez les aventures de plusieurs futures mariées qui recherchent LA robe de leurs rêves pour le plus beau jour de leur vie. Une boutique, deux clientes et leurs accompagnants vivront devant vous cette incroyable quête !

programme.title: Un trésor dans votre maison
programme.desc: Et si un trésor se cachait dans votre grenier ? Dans chaque épisode, un particulier nous ouvre ses portes, convaincu de posséder une pépite : timbres rares, bijoux de famille, vase ancien ou vieil instrument oublié. Il nous confie l'estimation qu'il en fait et ce qu'il rêve d'accomplir avec cette somme. Rendez-vous ensuite chez un commissaire-priseur, dont le verdict expert réserve parfois de crue

programme.title: La petite maison dans la prairie
programme.desc: Laura refuse de croire que l'ermite Amos Pike puisse être un dangereux maniaque. Elle décide de s'introduire dans sa maison, réputée hantée, afin de découvrir son secret….

programme.title: La petite maison dans la prairie
programme.desc: Laura croit avoir trouvé un filon d'or. Elle rêve que sa famille vit désormais dans l'opulence, comme les Oleson, et que son père n'a plus besoin de s'adresser au banquier du village...

programme.title: La petite maison dans la prairie
programme.desc: Il y a quelques mois, la tentative des Ingalls de marier leur ami M. Edwards à la veuve Snider a échoué. Ils profitent du traditionnel bal du printemps pour relancer leur projet...

programme.title: La petite maison dans la prairie
programme.desc: La veuve Julie Sanderson est atteinte d'une maladie incurable. Avant de mourir, elle doit impérativement trouver un foyer pour ses trois enfants. Elle demande de l'aide aux Ingalls….

Les membres de l’unité 118 travaillent une fois de plus pendant la nuit la plus effrayante de l'année et ne peuvent pas profiter de la fête. Les décorations d'Halloween de Buck sont encore plus terrifiantes qu’il ne l’avait imaginé.

D’anciennes blessures se réveillent lorsque les membres de la 118 se précipitent pour venir en aide à un homme confronté à une menace de divorce. Un petit garçon tombe dans un tuyau d’évacuation et s’y retrouve coincé. La 118 doit dépasser ses compétences habituelles pour le sauver.

Athena se voit confier une nouvelle recrue, le stagiaire Matthew Sparks, qui la fait douter de ses capacités. Le chef Simmons demande à Bobby d’assister la star Brad Torrance sur le tournage de la série « Cœurs de feu », dont la production est un généreux donateur pour la caserne.

La 118 se mobilise après l’explosion d’une canalisation qui a provoqué un carambolage. La popularité de l’acteur Brad Torrance, qui accompagne Nate en tant qu’observateur pour les besoins de la série « Cœurs de feu », complique l’intervention… Athena enquête après l'agression d'un jeune citoyen engagé qui luttait contre les incivilités sur les parkings de supermarché.

L'unité 118 intervient sur un incendie dans un refuge animalier et évacue d'urgence tous les animaux. Maddie reçoit un appel mystérieux qui l'entraîne dans une enquête personnelle aux conséquences inattendues.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: Ve siècle, île de Bretagne. Le royaume de Kaamelott s'organise autour de son souverain, le roi Arthur. Entouré de ses fidèles chevaliers de la Table Ronde, il s'attelle à la mission que les dieux lui ont confiée : rechercher le Saint Graal !

programme.title: Une vie rêvée
programme.desc: Sanem Aydın rêve de devenir écrivaine mais travaille dans l'épicerie familiale. Pour échapper à un mariage arrangé, elle accepte un poste dans une agence de publicité, où elle rencontre Can Divit, photographe baroudeur et nouveau patron. Entre eux, l'alchimie est immédiate mais les obstacles nombreux...

programme.title: Rretheqark
programme.desc: ”Rretheqark” është dritarja që hapet çdo mbrëmje mbi botën në lëvizje. Në një orë, zbulojmë labirintet e gjeopolitikës, aty ku pushtetet maten, aleancat ndryshojnë dhe diplomacia shkruan historinë në heshtje. Ju çojmë në prapaskenën e ngjarjeve që përcaktojnë ekuilibrat globale e rajonale. Një udhëtim rretheqark , për të parë jo vetëm çfarë ndodh, por edhe ku po shkon bota dhe rajoni.\r\n”Rretheqark”, cdo mbrëmje në orën, 22:00. Nga Rosalba Bejdo dhe Xhevahir Qardaku.”.

programme.desc: Edicioni qendror informativ, hapësira informative që trajton çështjet më të rëndësishme te dites. Analiza nga të ftuar dhe raportime live nga terreni.

programme.title: OFF the Record
programme.desc: ”Off the Record!” me Andrea Danglli ka si qëllim të sjellë në ekran misionin e gazetarisë së thelluar dhe analitike. Emisioni synon shtjellimin e një teme të caktuar që shqetëson shoqërinë nga e shkuara apo aktualiteti duke zbuluar përgjigjet e pikëpyetjeve të ngritura nga qytetarët përmes zërit të tyre, debatit apo informacionit për publikun.

programme.title: Tarzan
programme.desc: A contemporary spin on an old story. Two decades after his parents died in the African jungle, leaving him to be raised by apes, Tarzan's billionaire uncle has him captured and brought back to New York City. Escaping captivity, he meets a police detective named Jane, who is already romantically involved with another man, leaving her to choose between civilization and humanity.

programme.title: Greatest American Hero
programme.desc: While on a road trip through a desert, mild-mannered high-school teacher Ralph Hinkley (temporarily changed to Ralph Hanley for part of season one due to real-life current events) is greeted by extraterrestrials, who present him with an extraordinary red flying suit that imbues him with uncanny powers. Learning of the suit, high-strung FBI agent Bill Maxwell convinces Ralph to help him fight crime. Ralph's girlfriend, attorney Pam Davidson, also knows of his secret life as a superhero.

programme.title: Sue Thomas F.B.Eye
programme.desc: This light-hearted police drama follows a sheltered deaf woman who is about to start her first real job with the FBI. When she is given the tedious task of analyzing fingerprints, Sue is disappointed but doesn't remain there for long. An FBI agent discovers her ability to read lips and promotes Sue to an elite surveillance team. Suddenly, Sue and her hearing dog, Levi, are "G-Men," involved in a lot more action than they bargained for. This series is loosely based on the real-life deaf FBI agent Sue Thomas.

programme.title: The Trials of Rosie O'Neill
programme.desc: A successful private attorney takes a job as an L.A. County public defender after her divorce.

programme.title: The Commish
programme.desc: O.P.P. Commissioner, Julian Fantino talks to viewers. (Call-in).

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: This sprawling family saga takes place where an unfortunate tragedy has glued a family together to pull them through life's thick and thin moments. Follow young Amy Fleming as she slowly discovers she possesses her now-deceased mother's ability to aid injured horses as well as maintaining good relationships with those who are trying to get by one day at a time. The family pursues forgotten dreams and challenges as their strength is tested against personal struggles.

programme.title: Fokus Jerusalem
programme.desc: Israel, das Land der Bibel, ist auch ein Land der Konflikte. Hierbei immer im Fokus ist die Stadt Jerusalem – und das im doppelten Wortsinn: Denn "im Fokus" zu sein bedeutet nicht nur, im Zentrum des Interesses zu stehen, sondern auch, Brennpunkt zu sein. Ob zwischen Palästinensern und Israelis oder zwischen Christen, Juden und Muslimen: Immer wieder kommt es in Jerusalem zu Auseinandersetzungen.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.desc: Zusammen mit dem Filmemacher Sherman Mak durchstreift Cody die Straßen von Ho-Chi-Minh-Stadt, der größten Stadt Vietnams. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Josh besucht Estlands Hauptstadt Tallinn, bekannt für ihre mittelalterlichen Gebäude und düsteren Legenden. Gemeinsam mit einem lokalen Urban Explorer erkundet er abseits der bekannten Sehenswürdigkeiten ein altes sowjetisches Theater und ein Gefängnis, das unter dem Eis des Sees in einem ehemaligen Steinbruch verborgen liegt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Zusammen mit dem niederländischen Urban Explorer Govert Sweep verschlägt es Cody ins marokkanische Marrakesch. Dort treffen sie einen einheimischen BMX-Fahrer, der sie durch die Medina führt, das historische Stadtzentrum. Sie entdecken mit Graffiti verzierte Wände, nächtliche Märkte und ein "verbotenes" Hotel. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Berliner Geschichte(n): Josh begibt sich auf eine zweitägige Abenteuerreise durch die deutsche Hauptstadt und zeigt sie aus einer Perspektive, die vielen bislang verborgen blieb. Dabei verschlägt es ihn in das ehemalige Hauptquartier einer Spionagestation der Amerikaner aus dem Kalten Krieg und in eine verlassene Garage. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Cody entdeckt die unbekannte Schönheit von Georgiens Hauptstadt Tiflis, die vor allem für ihre verwinkelte Altstadt und wohltuenden Schwefelbäder bekannt ist. Den urbanen Entdecker interessieren aber besonders ein Luftschutzbunker aus dem Kalten Krieg, eine verlassene Wetterstation und eine alte Seilbahnstation. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Gemeinsam mit YouTube-Kollegin Lexie Limitless, die bereits mit 21 Jahren alle Länder der Welt bereist hat, erkundet Josh das französische Nantes auf einem mechanischen Elefanten und auf Inline-Skates. In der charmanten Stadt erwartet die beiden Entdecker eine verlassene Mine und ein pompöses Herrenhaus. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: In Thessaloniki, der zweitgrößten Stadt Griechenlands, bewegt sich Cody abseits der ausgetretenen Pfade. Auf einem Zug-Friedhof spaziert er über die ausrangierten Wagons. Und als ob das noch nicht aufregend genug wäre, besucht er noch eine Drohnenfabrik und taucht sogar zu einem Schiffswrack hinunter. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Josh macht sich auf ins Ruhrgebiet, wo verlassene Stahlfabriken und Bergwerke einen Einblick in das Leben eines Bergmannes bieten. Begleitet wird er dabei vom niederländischen YouTuber und Abenteurer Govert Sweep, der immer auf der Suche nach dem nächsten Urban-Exploring-Kick ist. Werden sie tief unter der Erde auf ihre Kosten kommen? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Die Isle of Wight im Süden Englands ist dank ihrer schönen Natur und des angenehmen Klimas vor allem als Ferienort sehr beliebt. Doch sie ist auch ein Paradies für Urban Explorer wie Cody. Zusammen mit seiner guten Freundin Elaina entdeckt er dort einen Leuchtturm aus dem Mittelalter und eine verlassene Ferienanlage. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Charleroi ist eine von der Industrie geprägte Stadt in der wallonischen Region Belgiens. Hier besucht Cody eine Fabrik, die vor langer Zeit aufgegeben wurde sowie einen weithin unbekannten Ort voller farbenfroher Graffitikunst. Außerdem wartet ein altes Casino nur darauf, von ihm erkundet zu werden. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Tattoo auf Kreuzfahrt
programme.desc: Rund 2500 Tattoo- und Metal-Fans, 50 weltbekannte Tattoo-Artists und 60 Tonnen Technik waren an Bord, als der Ozeanriese in Bremerhaven ablegte. Ski alpin: Weltcup
programme.desc: Ob Abfahrt oder Super-G, Slalom oder Riesenslalom: Das Programm im alpinen Ski-Weltcup ist vielfältig. Los geht es am 24. Oktober 2026 in Sölden mit dem Riesenslalom der Frauen. Einen Tag später starten dort auch die Männer in ihre Weltcup-Saison. Das Saisonhighlight bilden die Alpinen Ski-Weltmeisterschaften 2027 im schweizerischen Crans-Montana.

programme.title: Ski alpin: Weltcup
programme.desc: Vor einem Jahr erlebte Levi den ersten brasilianischen Weltcup-Sieger im Ski alpin: Lucas Pinheiro Braathen fuhr erstmals seit seinem Nationenwechsel ganz nach oben aufs Podest. Die Gastgeber durften sich derweil über einen dritte Platz des jungen Finnen Eduard Hallberg freuen. Das Podium komplettierte der Franzose Clément Noël. Enttäuschend endete der Saisonauftakt in Levi damals für die Schweize

programme.title: Snooker: WM
programme.desc: Im Finale standen sich der Chinese Wu Yize und der Engländer Shaun Murphy gegenüber. Der 22-jährige chinesische Shootingstar besiegte den Briten in einer Partie voller Wendungen mit 18:17 und wurde damit der zweitjüngste Snooker-Weltmeister der Geschichte. Die Weltmeisterschaft war der abschließende Wettbewerb der Saison 2025/26. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Jeux olympiques : Home of the Olympics
programme.desc: Retour sur les meilleurs moments des XXVes Jeux olympiques d'hiver de Milan-Cortina, qui ont eu lieu, en Italie, du 6 au 22 février 2026. Quelles nations ont remporté le plus de médailles et de titres, la France a-t-elle brillé avec ses biathlètes, ses skieurs et ses patineurs ? Quels ont été les plus beaux moments de cette olympiade italienne ? Le tout, résumé en une heure.

programme.title: 狄仁傑之通天謎案

programme.title: 虛擬特攻
programme.desc: 金牌保鏢龍威在妻子慘死後患上了創傷後應激障礙,心情低落。他意外結識高科技公司職員Amy,在她邀請下參加了新產品的虛擬測試。龍威測試成功後即成為該公司的虛擬特攻,更獲試用新發明的防護機甲,不料遭遇神秘武..

programme.title: Guns of Eden
programme.desc: 女警梅根與幾名好友到叢林露營度假,卻意外撞破當地腐敗警長非法處決毒販的血腥黑幕。驚覺罪行敗露的警長隨即懸賞萬元,聯合民兵封鎖整座大山展開血腥圍獵。身陷叢林深處、走投無路的梅根唯有帶領同伴深入虎穴,迎戰..

programme.title: 裂戰
programme.desc: 科學家顏欣培育出超級橡膠種子,赴毒販橫行的極端之地試種。國際安保隊長林翔奉命率隊保護前妻及其科研團隊,眾人剛抵達便遭跨國毒梟圍剿。林翔帶領生死弟兄,在吞噬人命的法外之地與多方勢力周旋,誓與敵人玉石俱焚..

programme.title: 零號追殺

programme.title: S0E2 - Loja e Fatit
programme.desc: Pas aksidentit, Bora i qëndron pranë Adës, e cila përpiqet të përballojë tradhtinë e Ryzgarit. E bindur se e ka ndjekur fati i keq i familjes, ajo vendos të luftojë për martesën. Për ta pasur Ryzgarin pranë, Ada kërkon punë në kompaninë ku ai punon.

programme.title: S0E6 - Krenari dhe Respekt
programme.desc: Lidhja mes Sibelit dhe Emirit duket se po shkon mirë. Por a do të heqë dorë Bora prej saj? Jiti vendos ta godasë Sadullahun në pikën e tij më të dobët, nderin. Ç’plan ka Jiti? Si do të hakmerret? Sadullahu përfiton nga gjendja e Zelihasë dhe mundohet t’i marrë shtëpinë. Nerimani ka planet e saj për Sibelin dhe Borën.

programme.title: S0E40 - Dashuri Bardhezi
programme.desc: Ferhati takohet me Azadin. Për çfarë do të bisedojnë ata? Xhemi i tregon Jigitit që Ebruja nuk është vajza e vërtetë e Shahinit. Asllëja merr një paralajmërim në punë. Çfarë reagimi do të bëjë Ferhati kur ta mësojë këtë gjë?

programme.title: S0E160 - Për Tim Bir
programme.desc: Serial/ Dramë: Zylfikari dhe Meltemi shkojnë për të takuar personin me të cilin figuron e martuar kjo e fundit. Çfarë do të ndodhë atje? Tani që gjakrat mes Sadretinit dhe Pojrazit janë qetësuar, Bahri Umani dhe të tjerët fillojnë të shqyrtojnë mundësitë për t’i shpëtuar rrezikut që i kanoset nga autoritetet.

programme.title: S0E66 - Rënia e Gjetheve
programme.desc: Nexhla dhe Oguzi bëjnë plane për t’u larguar së bashku në Gjermani, ndërsa ajo përpiqet të fshehë fajin përballë Lejlës. Pyetjet e Xhemit dhe presioni i Hajrijes e rëndojnë edhe më shumë, derisa Nexhla merr një vendim që trondit familjen.

programme.title: Kad lišće pada
programme.desc: Pas dorëheqjes së Ali Rizait dhe pranimit të Nexhlës në universitet, familja Tekin zhvendoset në Stamboll për një jetë të re. Mes vështirësive të përshtatjes dhe sfidave të qytetit të madh, Ali Rizai përpiqet ta mbajë familjen të bashkuar dhe të ruajë vlerat e ndershmërisë që e kanë udhëhequr gjithë jetën.

programme.title: Pitanje časti
programme.desc: Pasi djalit të vogël të shtëpisë, Emirit, i fillon stazhi në Stamboll, Zelihaja fillon planet për tu larguar. Por si do të reagojë vjehrri i saj kur ta marrë vesh këtë? Ajo e bind Hasanin të largohen, duke lënë çdo gjë pas dhe nisen drejt Stambollit. I afërmi i Zelihasë do t’i ndihmojë të ngrenë biznesin e tyre. Çfarë i premton Jiti të ëmës në ditën e tyre të parë në shtëpinë e re?

Бъдещето на империята е поставено на карта, а Луций трябва да върне славното име на Вечния град.

Сладко за двама – комедия, романтика . Рейчъл влиза в надпревара с времето, след като кленовата градина на семейство й започва да запада точно преди предстоящия „Фестивал на кленовия сироп“. Докато прекарват все повече време заедно, Били и Чарли неочаквано започват да изпитват силни чувства един към друг.

Грешният съпруг – трилър. Интуицията на Мелани не я подвежда, а съмненията се оказват основателни - еднояйчният близнак на съпруга заживява с нея, представяйки се за нейния съпруг, а зловещите му планове застрашават живота и на двамата.

Домът на мис Перигрин за чудати деца – фентъзи, приключенски, семеен . От режисьора-визионер Тим Бъртън, филмът е фантастично пътешествие, разказващо за момче на име Джейкъб (Аса Бътърфийлд), който открива таен свят за деца с необичайни сили.

Просто секс – комедия, романтика. Ема и Адам (Натали Портман и Аштън Къчър) решават да започнат чисто физическа връзка без да намесват романтични чувства. Много скоро обаче двамата разбират, че поддържането на такава връзка не е толкова лесно.

От местопрестъплението: Маями – сериал, сезон 7 . Сериалът проследява работата на екип от криминолози в Маями, които разкриват на пръв поглед неразгадаеми престъпления с помощта на зашеметяващи научни методи.

От местопрестъплението: Маями – сериал, сезон 7. Сериалът проследява работата на екип от криминолози в Маями, които разкриват на пръв поглед неразгадаеми престъпления с помощта на зашеметяващи научни методи.

Двойници – екшън, фантастика. Светът е идеален – хората живеят перфектен живот от домовете си - чрез роботи-двойници, които са физически съвършени механични репродукции на самите тях. Когато първото убийство след години разтърсва тази утопична картина, агентът на ФБР Гриър (Брус Уилис) открива огромна конспирация.

Можете ли да ми простите? – биографичен, комедия, криминален. Лий Израел е неуспяла писателка, която едва връзва двата края. Отчаяната липса на пари прави Израел доста избретателна - тя замисля схема за фалшифициране на писма от известни писатели и продажбата им на книжарници и колекционери.

The Robisons provide viewers with Bible-based advice to help them deal with everyday problems.

programme.title: 無名指
programme.desc: 鄧叔彥與楊靜嫻所組織的三口之家, 原本幸福快樂, 卻因為女兒鄧辭不幸患上重症, 很大可能活不過兩歲, 必須悲痛地面對生離死別。然而, 二人不懼前路茫茫, 許下承諾, 珍惜餘下的日子, 陪伴鄧辭走到終點。沒料到女兒奇蹟活過兩歲, 家庭卻因此遭逢巨變。為照顧女兒, 二人必須犧牲畢生的夢想和自由, 誰人能答允照顧終生的承諾呢?鄧叔彥斷送了壁球事業, 妻子更因抵不住壓力捨棄家庭。鄧叔彥一夜崩潰, 開始逃避家人並隱蔽於社會角落。失去了父母照料的鄧辭一直與嫲嫲孫友梅互相依靠樂天過活。直至嫲嫲的健康狀況變差, 鄧叔彥不能違背初心終於回家肩負起照顧鄧辭的責任。一對分隔十多年的父女, 又憑甚麼去戰勝彼此之間的積怨及心魔呢?誰也未料, 多年前的一個小默契成了二人釋放情感的缺口。在鄧叔彥的扶持下, 每況愈下的鄧辭僅靠一根無名指, 活出生命光彩, 重新連繫家人關顧的心。鄧叔彥細看女兒微動的無名指, 明白人與人之間

programme.desc: 一群悍匪以武力佔領了邊境小鎮忙崖, 鎮內只有3位民警, 1支手槍, 他們如何將44個匪徒就地正法?首執導筒的張琪現身說法, 解說電影背後的創作意念。當提及戲中的悍匪是否改編自真實人物時, 他大爆原來是取材自中國四大匪王及香港賊王葉繼歡, 他更詳盡解釋暴力鏡頭背後的創作動機。

programme.title: 大風殺
programme.desc: 挑戰1996全民禁槍話題, 引爆最癲最火最喪犯罪風暴!禁槍政策實施的前一年, 藏匿巨額寶藏的悍匪頭目越獄出逃, 帶領一眾匪徒武裝佔領了廢棄小鎮忙崖!趁巨型沙塵暴肆虐, 他們封鎖全鎮, 斷油斷訊, 救兵無門, 居民無路可逃!鎮內僅餘的3位民警, 面對兇徒屠殺平民, 誓死血戰守護家園。匪徒內鬨, 分贓不均, 上演狗咬狗的困獸之鬥。1支手槍3個兵, 如何將44個悍匪就地正法?

programme.title: 惡行之外
programme.desc: 某個雨夜, 香港刑偵警察樂一言的獨生女樂嘉琪被發現伏屍郊外。 警方根據線索, 把犯罪嫌疑人鎖定在邱俊文身上。但在調查期間又接連發生幾起少女被殺案件, 受害人與樂嘉琪有着一樣的腿部特徵, 警方開始朝着連環殺人案的方向調查。 樂一言因與死者的關係,開始獨自調查一切。樂一言意外遇見弱智少女叮噹, 從其身上發現女兒死亡的線索。 與此同時, 呂議員的女兒呂希蓉險些遇害, 九死一生由嫌犯身邊逃脫, 結合呂希蓉提供的線索, 樂一言根據目前的線索順藤摸瓜, 把兇手鎖定為邱俊文的父親宋境南。而宋境南亦因某些原因找上叮噹, 並試圖殺害叮噹。 樂一言及時出現救下叮噹, 宋境南暫時逃脫。 樂一言闖入邱俊文家中, 不料再次遇上宋境南與其扭打在一起。 樂一言與警察相互配合, 把邱家一家三口堵到天台上, 宋境南才說出實情。原來樂一言的女兒目睹邱俊文與叮噹的違法交易, 被邱俊文殺害。 宋境南為了幫兒子脫罪, 把此案件偽裝

programme.title: 猛鬼差館
programme.desc: 香港有一間警局, 三十年前曾是日軍侵略香港時的軍營。因為戰敗, 日本軍官在裡面切腹自殺了。據說他們的陰魂不散, 魂魄依然逗留在這所警局當中, 並會在孟蘭節當天出沒。金麥基與孟超都在這所警局裡面當員警, 但他們一直不相信警局裡面的恐怖傳說。小偷蛇仔明被囚於拘留所內竟誤闖鬼門關, 將惡鬼大佐放出, 自己亦被噬變成僵屍, 正欲逃離差館, 不料被死對頭仔寶神探金麥基與孟超所擒, 兩人不信蛇仔明已成新鬼, 結果太陽一出來, 蛇仔明即為飛灰, 他們才相信警局內的確有陰魂。他們把情況報告上司芬妮正想查明真相, 又遇到了一女子疑似被僵屍咬後死去了, 死狀似遭獸噬, 兩人知定是大佐所為, 遂引芬妮到驗房監視女屍, 鬼王也出場了...

programme.title: 芭啦芭啦櫻之花
programme.desc: 上海一舞蹈中心的舞蹈老師王錦勝, 由於天生的嚴重色盲, 只能生活在一個灰色世界當中, 加上曾經有過的一段感情創傷, 令他對愛情相望而卻步。一天, 王錦勝到街上做宣傳活動時, 遇上了混進宣傳隊伍中的樂兒。兩個素未謀面的人, 跳起舞來竟是極為默契, 這讓雙方對彼此印象深刻...

programme.title: 無名指
programme.desc: 鄧叔彥與楊靜嫻所組織的三口之家, 原本幸福快樂, 卻因為女兒鄧辭不幸患上重症, 很大可能活不過兩歲, 必須悲痛地面對生離死別。然而, 二人不懼前路茫茫, 許下承諾, 珍惜餘下的日子, 陪伴鄧辭走到終點。沒料到女兒奇蹟活過兩歲, 家庭卻因此遭逢巨變。為照顧女兒, 二人必須犧牲畢生的夢想和自由, 誰人能答允照顧終生的承諾呢?鄧叔彥斷送了壁球事業, 妻子更因抵不住壓力捨棄家庭。鄧叔彥一夜崩潰, 開始逃避家人並隱蔽於社會角落。失去了父母照料的鄧辭一直與嫲嫲孫友梅互相依靠樂天過活。直至嫲嫲的健康狀況變差, 鄧叔彥不能違背初心終於回家肩負起照顧鄧辭的責任。一對分隔十多年的父女, 又憑甚麼去戰勝彼此之間的積怨及心魔呢?誰也未料, 多年前的一個小默契成了二人釋放情感的缺口。在鄧叔彥的扶持下, 每況愈下的鄧辭僅靠一根無名指, 活出生命光彩, 重新連繫家人關顧的心。鄧叔彥細看女兒微動的無名指, 明白人與人之間

programme.title: 肌智整容大叔
programme.desc: 極具生意頭腦但游手好閒的地膽大國, 意外認識了技術高超但被釘牌的整容醫生智友, 二人一拍即合, 雄心壯志的大國勢要改寫韓國整容史!憑著打滾多年的社交手腕, 大國成功接通黑白窿路, 整容醫院不僅迅速爆紅, 更衝出國際吸引外國人來組團換臉。當他倆的整容帝國如日中天時, 背後卻有人對他們的生意虎視眈眈...成功令無數醜女改寫命運的大國, 今次能否幫自己大翻身?

programme.title: 爆谷製造
programme.desc: 一群悍匪以武力佔領了邊境小鎮忙崖, 鎮內只有3位民警, 1支手槍, 他們如何將44個匪徒就地正法?首執導筒的張琪現身說法, 解說電影背後的創作意念。當提及戲中的悍匪是否改編自真實人物時, 他大爆原來是取材自中國四大匪王及香港賊王葉繼歡, 他更詳盡解釋暴力鏡頭背後的創作動機。

programme.title: 大風殺
programme.desc: 挑戰1996全民禁槍話題, 引爆最癲最火最喪犯罪風暴!禁槍政策實施的前一年, 藏匿巨額寶藏的悍匪頭目越獄出逃, 帶領一眾匪徒武裝佔領了廢棄小鎮忙崖!趁巨型沙塵暴肆虐, 他們封鎖全鎮, 斷油斷訊, 救兵無門, 居民無路可逃!鎮內僅餘的3位民警, 面對兇徒屠殺平民, 誓死血戰守護家園。匪徒內鬨, 分贓不均, 上演狗咬狗的困獸之鬥。1支手槍3個兵, 如何將44個悍匪就地正法?

programme.title: 惡行之外
programme.desc: 某個雨夜, 香港刑偵警察樂一言的獨生女樂嘉琪被發現伏屍郊外。 警方根據線索, 把犯罪嫌疑人鎖定在邱俊文身上。但在調查期間又接連發生幾起少女被殺案件, 受害人與樂嘉琪有着一樣的腿部特徵, 警方開始朝着連環殺人案的方向調查。 樂一言因與死者的關係,開始獨自調查一切。樂一言意外遇見弱智少女叮噹, 從其身上發現女兒死亡的線索。 與此同時, 呂議員的女兒呂希蓉險些遇害, 九死一生由嫌犯身邊逃脫, 結合呂希蓉提供的線索, 樂一言根據目前的線索順藤摸瓜, 把兇手鎖定為邱俊文的父親宋境南。而宋境南亦因某些原因找上叮噹, 並試圖殺害叮噹。 樂一言及時出現救下叮噹, 宋境南暫時逃脫。 樂一言闖入邱俊文家中, 不料再次遇上宋境南與其扭打在一起。 樂一言與警察相互配合, 把邱家一家三口堵到天台上, 宋境南才說出實情。原來樂一言的女兒目睹邱俊文與叮噹的違法交易, 被邱俊文殺害。 宋境南為了幫兒子脫罪, 把此案件偽裝

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場 第287集
programme.desc: 爆谷獨有電影大師組成的幕後精英超強班底, 每集全天候報導電影拍攝現場精彩過程, 獨家訪問, 第一次曝光電影片段。爆谷台瞭解任何一部電影的誕生, 都是幕前幕後眾多精英心血與智慧的結晶, 所以節目會以尋常角度看待所有工作人員如何齊心協力建造屬於他們自己的「夢工廠」。

programme.title: 猛鬼差館
programme.desc: 香港有一間警局, 三十年前曾是日軍侵略香港時的軍營。因為戰敗, 日本軍官在裡面切腹自殺了。據說他們的陰魂不散, 魂魄依然逗留在這所警局當中, 並會在孟蘭節當天出沒。金麥基與孟超都在這所警局裡面當員警, 但他們一直不相信警局裡面的恐怖傳說。小偷蛇仔明被囚於拘留所內竟誤闖鬼門關, 將惡鬼大佐放出, 自己亦被噬變成僵屍, 正欲逃離差館, 不料被死對頭仔寶神探金麥基與孟超所擒, 兩人不信蛇仔明已成新鬼, 結果太陽一出來, 蛇仔明即為飛灰, 他們才相信警局內的確有陰魂。他們把情況報告上司芬妮正想查明真相, 又遇到了一女子疑似被僵屍咬後死去了, 死狀似遭獸噬, 兩人知定是大佐所為, 遂引芬妮到驗房監視女屍, 鬼王也出場了...

programme.title: 芭啦芭啦櫻之花
programme.desc: 上海一舞蹈中心的舞蹈老師王錦勝, 由於天生的嚴重色盲, 只能生活在一個灰色世界當中, 加上曾經有過的一段感情創傷, 令他對愛情相望而卻步。一天, 王錦勝到街上做宣傳活動時, 遇上了混進宣傳隊伍中的樂兒。兩個素未謀面的人, 跳起舞來竟是極為默契, 這讓雙方對彼此印象深刻...

programme.desc: Werbejingle-Komponist und Frauenheld Charlie (Sheen) gewährt seinem spießigen Bruder Alan (Jon Cryer) samt Nachwuchs Unterschlupf. Als cooler Onkel stellt er sofort den autoritären Erziehungsstil seines Bruders in Frage. Bis Jake einen Schwarm Möwen mit nach Hause bringt.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men
programme.desc: Im Suff planen Werbe-Jingle-Komponist Charlie und sein spießiger Bruder Alan, sich endlich gegen ihre Mutter Evelyn (Holland Taylor) durchzusetzen… \n\nSpaßerprobtes Doppel: Charlie Sheen und Serienbruder Jon Cryer standen schon für die Klamotte „Hot Shots“ (1991) gemeinsam vor der Kamera.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Weil Sheldon und Amy das einzige glückliche Paar sind, wollen Leonard und Penny ihre Krise überwinden, indem sie es ihren kauzigen Freunden gleichtun. Sie bitten Sheldon, einen Beziehungsvertrag aufzusetzen….

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Um die Gefühle seiner Freunde besser deuten zu können, stellt Sonderling Sheldon sich als Testperson für den neu entwickelten „Emotionen-Detektor“ zur Verfügung. Raj erhofft sich von einer lockeren Gesprächsrunde mit allen Ex-Freundinnen Aufschluss über die eigenen Defizite.

programme.title: How I Met Your Mother
programme.desc: Ein abgelegenes Hotel, ein Clown, eine verbitterte Exverlobte als Stripperin und ständig Anrufe von seiner genervten Braut: Barney (Neil Patrick Harris) ist alles andere als zufrieden mit seiner Bachelor-Party. Dann setzt er auch noch im Kasino Marshalls Leben als Pfand ein. Ist dieser Abend noch zu retten?

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.desc: Über eine Crowdfunding-Plattform will sich Caroline Geld für eine Designerhose sammeln. Sie findet die Idee großartig, Max hingegen ist tierisch genervt davon und ätzt in einer Rundmail gegen Caroline. Leider hat sie vergessen, ihre Freundin aus dem Verteiler zu nehmen….

programme.title: Two and a Half Men
programme.desc: Seit Jahren kümmert sich Berta um Charlies Haushalt und von Alan will sie sich bestimmt nicht vorschreiben lassen, wie sie nun diesen Job auszuführen hat. Sie kündigt und Alan hat seine liebe Not damit, einen Ersatz zu finden. Schließlich bekniet er doch wieder Berta, zurückzukehren, doch die bleibt stur. Bis Chiropraktiker Alan Bertas Schwachpunkt entdeckt – ein Lendenwirbelproblem….

programme.title: Two and a Half Men
programme.desc: Comedy Frauenheld Charlie (Sheen) besucht ein Fußballspiel seines Neffen. Obwohl Jakes Team verliert, hat Charlie allen Grund zu Jubeln: Die Mütter der kleinen Kicker sind attraktiv und geschieden… \n\nDas US-Publikum hatte den Spaß 2004 zur beliebtesten neuen Sitcom erkoren.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Weil Sheldon (Jim Parsons) ihnen auf den Nerv geht, schenken Leonard und Howard ihm einen Trip, auf dem er eine historische Eisenbahn fahren darf. Fortan nervt das Genie nur noch Amy mit seinem Zug-Gerede. Doch die Vorstellung von Sheldon als verschwitztem Lokführer kurbelt Amys Fantasie an.

programme.title: Geo
programme.desc: Geo, con Sveva Sagramola ed Emanuele Biggi. Documentari, notizie e curiosità sugli animali, progetti innovativi e stili di vita sostenibili. Un viaggio quotidiano tra le bellezze e le criticità del nostro Pianeta per capire come affrontare il cambiamento climatico e vivere in armonia con il mondo che ci circonda.

programme.title: Generazione Bellezza
programme.desc: Generazione Bellezza prova a chiarire la complessa evoluzione del patrimonio culturale, il quale viene chiesto sempre più di essere vero e proprio apparato "produttore di cultura", non più elemento statico. A musei e luoghi di cultura, di conseguenza, la richiesta è quella di essere elementi vivi e vitali delle città, ponti di connessione e trasmissione, ma anche di creazione e formazione del sape

programme.title: Il cavallo e la torre
programme.desc: Il fatto del giorno filtrato in 10 minuti dagli occhi e la sensibilità di Marco Damilano. Dal titolo di un libro di Vittorio Foa, la torre è il simbolo di chi fa una mossa ripetitiva, il cavallo salta e spiazza.

programme.title: Un posto al sole
programme.desc: Soap italien racontant le quotidien des habitants du prestigieux Palazzo di Palladini, ancienne propriété de l'aristocrate Napolitain Giacomo Palladini, qui surplombe le Golf de Naples et le Vésuve. A sa mort, le compte Palladini lègue l'appartement le plus prestigieux, appelé "La terrazza" en raison de sa vue imprenable, à sa dernière fille naturelle, Anna Boschi, qu'il a eue avec la gouvernante.

programme.title: Il Filo Rosso
programme.desc: "Il filo rosso" è quello che tiene uniti i nonni e i nipoti, legando le generazioni di ieri a quelle di oggi. Attraverso le storie di questi nonni e di questi nipoti verranno affrontati argomenti e temi sociali di vario genere,.

programme.title: TG3 Linea notte
programme.desc: Servizi delle principali edizioni del TG3, le rubriche e gli specialiTG3 Linea notte.

programme.title: TG Magazine
programme.desc: Un contenuto televisivo dedicato a temi di attualità.

programme.title: Agorà
programme.desc: Agorà ha un obiettivo ambizioso: vuole raccontare l'Italia attraverso la politica. Agorà vuole ripristinare il corretto contatto tra la politica e le persone. Vuole proporre e favorire un dialogo sui temi concreti, partendo dall'attualità, dalla vita di tutti i giorni, vietando il facile ricorso al politichese per eludere il contenuto reale dei problemi.

programme.title: Agorà Extra
programme.desc: Agorà Extra ha un obiettivo ambizioso: vuole raccontare l'Italia attraverso la politica. Agorà vuole ripristinare il corretto contatto tra la politica e le persone.

programme.title: Elisir
programme.desc: Il programma di salute e benessere della mattina di Rai3. La trasmissione vuole essere vicina al pubblico aiutandolo ad orientarsi in un panorama ogni giorno più ricco di informazioni mediche...

programme.title: Quante storie
programme.desc: Ogni giorno storie, personaggi e temi con l'intento di approfondire alcuni aspetti della complessità che ci circonda. Dall'arte alla letteratura, dalla musica alla storia recente, dalla filosofia alla politica, Giorgio Zanchini e i suoi ospiti offrono spunti di riflessione per comprendere le mille facce di un paese meraviglioso e contraddittorio.

programme.title: Passato e presente
programme.desc: Un accademico di fama e tre giovani studenti che aspirano ad essere gli storici del futuro ne discutono con Paolo Mieli. La narrazione avverrà attraverso il confronto tra i loro diversipunti di vista. Il rigore della ricerca e la suggestione delle immagini per un grand e racconto tra passato e presente.

programme.title: TGR Leonardo
programme.desc: Il programma che unisce l'attenzione all'attualità del quotidiano con il rigore della documentazione e dell'approfondimento scientifico. Tra gli argomanti trattati ci sono non solo scienza e tecnologia, ma anche salute, ambiente, economia, società.

programme.title: TGR Piazza Affari
programme.desc: Il notiziario economico quotidiano. Ultime notizie di economia e sull'andamento della borsa. Programma di Ines Maggiolinia a cura della redazione economica della TGR Lombardia.

Die Gelegenheit bietet sich schneller als gedacht, denn seine Tochter möchte aus ihrem Mutterkuchen Globuli fürs Kind herstellen lassen. Ja,

programme.title: Die Kirche bleibt im Dorf
programme.desc: L'arrivée du pasteur Köster, issu d'Allemagne du Nord au sein d'une église partagée depuis le Moyen-Âge entre deux villages aux us et coutumes totalement nouvelles pour lui, aux querelles incessantes et aux personnalités loufoques, ce qui entraîne des situations cocasses où l'humour est omniprésent.

programme.title: Koch ein!
programme.desc: Timo Böckle zeigt, wie einfach es ist, den knalligen Rotkohl im Vorratsschrank so richtig in Szene zu setzen. Für den "Asiastyle" sorgen Ingwer, Chili und ordentlich Knoblauch. Der Kohl kostet nicht viel, ist ruckzuck im Einmachglas und das Beste: Man kann das leckere Gemüse noch lange nach der Rotkohlsaison kalt oder warm genießen. Klingt gut? Ist gut!

programme.title: Kaffee oder Tee
programme.desc: Das tägliche Service-Magazin bietet praktische Tipps und Informationen rund um die Themen Heim und Garten, Gesundheit, Küche und Haushalt. Experten geben hilfreiche Ratschläge für den Alltag und vermitteln Wissenswertes zu zahlreichen Lebensbereichen. programme.title: aktueller bericht
programme.desc: Was auch immer passiert, das Infomagazin ist einfach dichter dran - mit Reporterberichten, Nachrichtenfilmen, Meldungen, Kommentaren und der Meinung unserer Zuschauerinnen und Zuschauer. Diese können sich täglich mit ihren Fragen und Diskussionsbeiträgen direkt via Telefon an Experten im Fernsehstudio wenden. Reporterinnen und Reporter sind ständig vor Ort, wenn es aktuelle Probleme gibt.

programme.title: Panoramablick
programme.desc: Die Sendung zeigt live an rund 40 Standorten, wie das Wetter an den schönsten Orten in Baden-Württemberg, Rheinland-Pfalz, dem Saarland und angrenzenden Nachbarländern ist. Scheint auf den Gipfeln die Sonne? Sind im Winter die Pisten präpariert und laufen die Lifte? Regnet es am Zielort und muss die Wanderung dem Museumsbesuch weichen? Die Wetterbilder helfen bei der Freizeitgestaltung genauso wie

programme.title: Eisenbahn-Romantik
programme.desc: Wien ist vieles auf einmal: wunderbar altmodisch und hochmodern. Welche Metropole hat schon eine Stadtbahn mit Stationen, die welterbewürdig sind und mittlerweile von U-Bahnen angefahren werden. Und da gibt es ja auch noch den neuen Hauptbahnhof, mit dem Wien endlich das heiß ersehnte Drehkreuz für den Eisenbahnverkehr bekam. Wie einst zu Kaisers Zeiten zuckelt die Straßenbahn durch enge Gassen.

programme.title: Sturm der Liebe
programme.desc: Fürstenhof, hôtel cinq étoile au cœur de Vagen en Bavière, est l'épicentre des histoires qui lient de nombreux habitants de la région. Qu'il s'agisse de ses propriétaires, son petit personnel ou d'autres personnalités influentes, les intrigues mêlant amour, argent, famille et trahison qui gravitent autour de l'établissement sont nombreuses.

programme.title: aktiv und gesund
programme.desc: Stress erhöht das Risiko für Herzerkrankungen und führt sogar dazu, dass Knochenbrüche schlechter heilen. Diese Tatsache ist nur ein Beispiel dafür, wie unsere Knochen unter zu viel Stress leiden. Eine bekannte und weit verbreitete Folge von Stress sind Nacken- und Rückenschmerzen. Auch wird überprüft, ob sich Allulose und Mönchsfrucht als Alternativen zu Haushaltszucker eignen.

programme.title: Ihr letzter Wille kann mich mal!
programme.desc: Der korrekte Staatsanwalt Heinrich Gruber und der esoterisch interessierte Journalist Tom Gruber haben eigentlich wenig gemeinsam. Umso mehr staunen die Herren, als sie sich bei einer Testamentseröffnung kennenlernen - und zwar als Ehemänner der Verstorbenen. Die tödlich verunglückte Sophia hatte jahrzehntelang ein Doppelleben geführt und äußert in ihrem letzten Willen einen ungewöhnlichen Wunsch.

programme.title: Hubert und Staller
programme.desc: In Staffel 6 erlebt das Ermittlerduo Franz Hubert und Johannes Staller große Herausforderungen und ein überraschendes Wiedersehen. Hubert wacht z.B. nach einer wilden Party neben seiner Ex-Frau – der Pathologin Dr. Anja Licht – auf und kann sich an nichts erinnern. In einer anderen Episode sitzt Staller nach einem Autounfall kurzzeitig im Rollstuhl. Der Humor kommt nie zu kurz!

programme.title: Virus-32
programme.desc: A virus spreads throughout the city, causing the infected to become vicious hunters. Iris and her daughter become caught in the massacre, discovering 32-second periods of calm before each attack.

programme.title: Almost Human
programme.desc: Seth sees his best friend disappear in a flash of light. Two years later, Seth is still dealing with the fallout and suspicions when a series of grisly murders rocks the community.

programme.title: The Sadness
programme.desc: As Taiwan succumbs to a viral pandemic that transforms peaceful citizens into sadistic, bloodthirsty maniacs, a young couple must battle to be reunited before they too become infected.

programme.title: Devil's Pass
programme.desc: To determine what happened to some Russian hikers, five U.S. college students go back to where the hikers were found dead. The students don't return from the expedition, either, and the recovered footage is deemed too disturbing for public viewing.

programme.title: Contracted
programme.desc: A young woman (Najarra Townsend) begins bleeding, shedding maggots and hallucinating after a stranger date rapes her at a party.

programme.title: Allegoria
programme.desc: A timid actress, a tortured painter, a pretentious writer, a psychotic sculptor and a rock band all become entangled when their insecurities manifest themselves into monsters and ghouls.

programme.title: Blood Flower
programme.desc: A young apprentice healer tries to suppress his supernatural abilities so he can fit in with the other kids, but when a malicious spirit breaks out in his apartment he decides to use his abilities while dark family secrets are revealed.

programme.title: Revealer
programme.desc: A stripper and a religious protester are trapped together in a peep show booth and must come together to survive the apocalypse.

programme.title: Scare Package
programme.desc: Seven filmmakers present seven terrifying and comedic tales of horror.

programme.title: PG: Psycho Goreman
programme.desc: Intergalactic assassins converge on a small town after two siblings unwittingly resurrect an ancient alien overlord.

programme.title: All the Creatures Were Stirring
programme.desc: The joyful spirit of Christmas takes one dark turn after another -- from sadistic office parties and last-minute shopping nightmares to vengeful stalkers and immortal demons.

programme.title: Glorious
programme.desc: A heartbroken man finds himself trapped in a bathroom with a strange voice who says he may be the only hope in stopping a terrible event.

programme.title: Skull: The Mask
programme.desc: A supernatural serial killer based on pre-Colombian mythology hunts for revenge in the metropolis of São Paulo.

programme.title: MadS
programme.desc: Eighteen-year-old Romain has just graduated and makes a stop at his dealer's place to try a new pill. As he heads off to a party, he sees an injured woman on the side of the road and decides to help her, but when she gets in his car, she suddenly smashes her own head against the dashboard, bleeding out until she dies.

programme.title: Blood Glacier
programme.desc: Scientists discover that a red liquid leaking from a nearby glacier contains organisms that turn living hosts into deadly mutants.

programme.title: The Hallow
programme.desc: A family is forced to fight demonic creatures for survival after they move into a remote mill house in Ireland.

programme.title: Superdeep
programme.desc: In 1984 a Russian research team goes below the surface to find out what secret the world's deepest borehole is hiding. On their expedition, something unexpectedly gruesome awaits the researchers.

programme.title: Mon Mon Mon Monsters
programme.desc: While assigned to community duty, teenagers stumble upon a flesh-eating female ghoul and decide to capture her.

programme.title: Last Ones Out
programme.desc: A skeptical American is stranded in the middle of a zombie-infected Africa and must rely on the help of three mysterious strangers to make it out alive.

programme.title: Alone
programme.desc: Teenage delinquents who are living in an island youth center wake up to find themselves alone with no one to watch over them. After much partying, they realize the island has been deserted and the adults have been infected by a mysterious epidemic.

programme.title: Dead Shack
programme.desc: On a weekend getaway at a rundown cottage in the woods, a 14-year-old teen, his best friend, and his best friend's older sister must work together to save their hard-partying parents from their predatory person in the cabin next to them.

programme.title: Mandrake
programme.desc: Probation officer Cathy Madden is given the task of rehabilitating notorious killer "Bloody" Mary Laidlaw back into society after 20 years in jail. Cathy's beliefs are firmly tested when two children disappear near Mary's farm.

The kids discover their neighborhood was designated as a historical landmark but they must prove it before Scheck moves in with his crew.

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: Perpetual adversaries SpongeBob and Plankton join forces and come ashore to battle a pirate who has plans for the stolen Krabby Patties recipe.

programme.title: Rango
programme.desc: A chameleon who has lived as a sheltered family pet finds himself in the grip of an identity crisis. Rango wonders how to stand out when it is his nature to blend in. When he accidentally winds up in a frontier town called Dirt, he takes the first step on a transformational journey as the town's new sheriff. Though at first Rango only role-plays, a series of thrilling situations and outrageous encounters forces him to become a real hero.

rating.system: Saskatchewan Film and Video Classification Board

Picard (Patrick Stewart), learns that one of the disaster's survivors, Dr. Soran (Malcolm McDowell), plans to enter the field by destroying a neighboring star. Picard now must collaborate with an unlikely ally in order to stop him.

Data battle the Borg Queen as she tries to take over the Enterprise.

rating.system: Instituto Nacional de Cine y Artes Audiovisuales

programme.title: Grumpier Old Men

Botched matchmaking leads to some major romantic mix-ups, until an unexpected death in the family helps everyone realize that the most important thing in life is love.

programme.title: The Wedding Singer

He falls in love with her and must win her over before she gets married.

programme.title: The Terminal
programme.desc: When Viktor Navorski (Tom Hanks), an Eastern European tourist, arrives at JFK in New York, war breaks out in his country, and he finds himself caught up in international politics. Because of the war, the Department of Homeland Security won't let him enter or exit the United States. He's trapped at JFK -- indefinitely. While living at the airport, Viktor falls for a flight attendant (Catherine Zeta-Jones). She may have feelings for him too. But what good is love if Viktor can't leave the terminal?

programme.title: Serendipity
programme.desc: On a magical night when they are in their 20s, Jonathan (John Cusack) meets Sara (Kate Beckinsale). He finds it love at first sight, but Sara believes in destiny. After 10 years the two -- with 3,000 miles between them -- must decide if fate wants them to be together again. When love feels like magic, it is called destiny; when destiny has a sense of humor, it is serendipity.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: Moving in from Chicago, newcomer Ren McCormack (Kevin Bacon) is in shock when he discovers the small Midwestern town he now calls home has made dancing and rock music illegal. As he struggles to fit in, Ren faces an uphill battle to change things. With the help of his new friend, Willard Hewitt (Christopher Penn), and defiant teen Ariel Moore (Lori Singer), he might loosen up this conservative town. But Ariel's influential father, Reverend Shaw Moore (John Lithgow), stands in the way.

programme.title: Appels d'urgence

programme.title: Appels d'urgence

programme.title: Appels d'urgence

programme.title: Appels d'urgence

programme.desc: Acis et Galatée de Jean-Baptiste Lully est une pastorale héroïque mêlant amour, mythologie et spectacle. L'œuvre raconte l'idylle entre Galatée et Acis, bouleversée par le cyclope Polyphème. Riche en danses et en chœurs, elle illustre le faste de la cour de Louis XIV et compte parmi les chefs-d'œuvre du répertoire baroque.

programme.desc: Ewa rodzi drugiego syna. Leszek studiuje weterynarię. Spokojne życie braci Talarów zakłóca wiadomość o śmierci ojca. Andrzej sprzedaje gospodarstwo i zabiera matkę do siebie. Ewa usiłuje prowadzić wielkomiejskie życie: urządza imieniny Andrzeja, podczas których znika jego matka, jak się okazuje - wyproszona z domu przez synową. Poszukiwania matki Andrzeja nie dają rezultatu.

programme.title: Przez pamięć i zapomnienie

programme.title: Komisarz Alex
programme.desc: Legendarny muzyk Jonasz Kieres ginie w wypadku samochodowym. Szybko okazuje się, że ktoś celowo uszkodził jego auto i doprowadził do śmiertelnej kraksy. Wraz z postępem śledztwa Alex, Monika i Gutek typują troje głównych podejrzanych.

programme.title: Dans la tourmente
programme.desc: Sous la terreur stalinienne, une femme, professeur d'université, est condamnée à dix ans de travaux forcés. Elle est déportée en Sibérie et découvre le goulag.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Ksawery kontynuuje swój bunt, kategorycznie odmawiając wyjścia do szkoły. Kiedy Kasia dzieli się problemami rodzinnymi z dyrektorką Niedzielską, nastolatek niespodziewanie ucieka. Z kolei Malwina doświadcza chwilowego kryzysu emocjonalnego.

programme.title: Komisarz Alex

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia

programme.title: Niezwykłe miejsca

programme.title: Ojciec Mateusz

W parku znaleziono kolejnego martwego mężczyznę. Sekcja wskazuje na zatrucie alkaloidem. Trop prowadzi do kościoła. Okazuje się, że ktoś chciał otruć księdza Mateusza.

programme.title: Please Believe Me
programme.desc: A young English woman, Alison Kirbe (Deborah Kerr), inherits a Texas ranch and heads to America to start a new and prosperous life, having no idea of the sort of man trouble she'll attract. A gambler in debt, Terence Keath (Robert Walker), pursues her. But so does another bachelor on the hunt, playboy Jeremy Taylor (Peter Lawford), who is traveling with his lawyer, Matthew Kinston (Mark Stevens), to whom Kirbe is most attracted. Unfortunately for her, he thinks she's running a scam.

programme.title: The Law in Her Hands
programme.desc: A defense lawyer (Margaret Lindsay) sets her career goals aside to marry a district attorney (Warren Hull).

programme.title: Just This Once
programme.desc: Mark MacLene (Peter Lawford) is a millionaire playboy, but he won't be one much longer if he keeps blowing through his inheritance. In an effort to control his spending, Mark's executor, Judge Samuel Coulter (Lewis Stone), hires lawyer Lucy Duncan (Janet Leigh) to watch over Mark. The two are even forced to live together, much to the dismay of Lucy's boyfriend, Tom (Richard Anderson). At first Mark tries to ditch Lucy and her frugal ways, but soon he finds himself falling for her.

programme.title: The Reformer and the Redhead
programme.desc: Dr. Kevin G. Maguire (Cecil Kellaway) and his daughter, Kathleen (June Allyson), work at the local zoo as the superintendent and tour guide, respectively. As such, they believe that all animals should be treated with kindness, which conflicts with the views of a powerful and crooked political boss (Ray Collins). When the boss has Maguire fired due to this difference, Kathleen springs into action by contacting an attorney and mayoral hopeful (Dick Powell) for help in saving her father's job.

programme.title: Adam's Rib
programme.desc: A courtroom rivalry finds its way into the household when prosecuting lawyer Adam Bonner (Spencer Tracy) faces off against his wife, Amanda (Katharine Hepburn), who happens to be a defense attorney. Working on opposite sides of a lawsuit where a woman (Judy Holliday) has shot her cheating husband (Tom Ewell), Adam and Amanda are both determined to win the case, and their home becomes the setting for comical showdowns, with neither spouse willing to relent.

programme.title: The Glenn Miller Story
programme.desc: Glenn Miller (James Stewart) is a poor trombone player with dreams of fame. Eventually, through years of hard work and determination, he is able to start his own band, and they become one of the most successful groups of the big-band era. With a beautiful wife (June Allyson) and one of the biggest songs in America, "Moonlight Serenade," Miller has it all. But at the onset of World War II, Miller enlists, giving up his fame and success to help entertain the troops stationed in Europe.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The Fabulous Dorseys
programme.desc: Growing up in a coal-mining community in Philadelphia, Tommy and Jimmy Dorsey (playing themselves) are encouraged by their father, Thomas (Arthur Shields), to study music. The highly competitive siblings are soon playing with their father's band. As grown men, the Dorseys begin touring with their own ensemble, with childhood friend Jane Howard (Janet Blair) on vocals. Despite their rising success, the bickering brothers have a falling out, and Jane schemes to reconcile them.

programme.title: The Gene Krupa Story
programme.desc: This musical biopic is based on the life of Gene Krupa (Sal Mineo), the famed jazz drummer. His Catholic parents want him to be a priest, but Krupa rebels and moves away to make it as a musician in New York City, along with his friend Eddie (James Darren). He eventually falls for a girl, Ethel (Susan Kohner). But the seductions of other women, drugs and fame -- plus a lack of a formal music education -- put a strain on his personal and professional life, and Krupa must re-examine his goals.

programme.title: Cabin in the Sky
programme.desc: When compulsive gambler Little Joe Jackson (Eddie "Rochester" Anderson) dies in a drunken fight, he awakens in purgatory, where he learns that he will be sent back to Earth for six months to prove that he deserves to be in heaven. He awakens, remembering nothing and struggles to do right by his devout wife, Petunia (Ethel Waters), while an angel known as the General (Kenneth Spencer) and the devil's son, Lucifer Jr. (Rex Ingram), fight for his soul.

programme.title: Reet, Petite and Gone
programme.desc: To claim his inheritance a jazzman (Louis Jordan) must find the right kind of woman.

programme.title: Hi-De-Ho
programme.desc: Fast-talking manager Nettie (Ida James) helps legendary jazz bandleader Cab Calloway (Cab Calloway) land a steady gig at the exclusive Brass Hat Club. Upon hearing the good news, Calloway's untrusting girlfriend, Minnie (Jeni Le Gon), mistakenly assumes that he and Nettie are having an affair. As Calloway and his band prepare for their maiden performance at the Brass Hat, the vengeful Minnie asks Boss Mason (George Wiltshire) -- the thuggish owner of a competing club -- to put a hit on her man.

programme.title: Mystery Street
programme.desc: When bargirl Vivian (Jan Sterling) discovers that her married boyfriend has refused to leave his wife, she steals a car and drives to Cape Cod to confront him. Several months later her skeleton washes ashore, and local police officer Peter Moralas (Ricardo Montalban) must work with Harvard forensics expert Dr. McAdoo (Bruce Bennett) in order to piece together the twisted tale and discover who the murderer is before an innocent suspect pays the ultimate price.

programme.title: Bad Day at Black Rock
programme.desc: When John J. Macreedy (Spencer Tracy), a one-armed war veteran, arrives in the small desert town of Black Rock, he's not greeted warmly. Searching for a man named Komoko, Macreedy is met with disdain by virtually every local, including the resident thug, Hector David (Lee Marvin), and the imposing Reno Smith (Robert Ryan). As Macreedy's investigation deepens, hostility turns to violence -- and to imminent danger for the mysterious and inquisitive stranger.

programme.title: Edge of Doom
programme.desc: After the death of his ailing mother, Martin Lynn (Farley Granger) feels desperately alone. His only concern is that his mother receive an elegant burial. Unfortunately, Martin is also in a dire financial situation and cannot afford an expensive church service. Enraged, Martin viciously directs his frustrations at a clergyman, killing him. The impulsive act leaves Martin in an even more despondent state, though a kindly priest (Dana Andrews) may be able to guide the young man toward redemption.

programme.title: Witness for the Prosecution
programme.desc: The affable Leonard Vole (Tyrone Power) is being tried for the murder of a wealthy woman, and legendary lawyer Sir Wilfrid Robarts (Charles Laughton) has chosen to represent him. Unfortunately, Leonard's alibi depends on the testimony of his callous wife, Christine (Marlene Dietrich) -- who, after the discovery of a legal loophole, makes the shocking decision to appear in court against him. To Sir Wilfrid's surprise, this is only the first in a series of puzzling revelations and reversals.

programme.title: Seven Days in May

When Scott's aide, Martin "Jiggs" Casey (Kirk Douglas) stumbles on shattering evidence that the General is plotting a coup to overthrow Lyman in seven days, "Jiggs" alerts the President, setting off a dangerous race to thwart the takeover.

programme.title: The Swimmer
programme.desc: Well-off ad man Ned Merrill (Burt Lancaster) is visiting a friend when he notices the abundance of backyard pools that populate their upscale suburb. Ned suddenly decides that he'd like to travel the eight miles back to his own home by simply swimming across every pool in town. Soon, Ned's journey becomes harrowing; at each house, he is somehow confronted with a reminder of his romantic, domestic and economic failures, until a final visit with an old flame (Janice Rule) leaves him devastated.

programme.title: The Professionals
programme.desc: Four soldiers of fortune are hired by a wealthy rancher to rescue his beautiful young wife who has been kidnapped by a villainous Mexican bandit. When they finally find her, after fighting their way across deserts and mountains, they discover she is not being held against her will. This causes friction within the band as to whether they should honor their agreement.

programme.title: Birdman of Alcatraz
programme.desc: Sentenced to life in solitary confinement after killing a prison guard, despondent inmate Robert Stroud (Burt Lancaster) combats loneliness and tedium by nursing an ailing bird back to health. Stroud develops an interest in caring for birds and becomes a talented ornithologist. After publishing a book on bird diseases from jail, he meets and marries Stella (Betty Field), a fellow bird enthusiast. When Stroud is suddenly moved to Alcatraz, though, his marriage and work are both threatened.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Elmer Gantry
programme.desc: When hedonistic but charming con man Elmer Gantry (Burt Lancaster) meets the beautiful Sister Sharon Falconer (Jean Simmons), a roadside revivalist, he feigns piousness to join her act as a passionate preacher. The two make a successful onstage pair, and their chemistry extends to romance. Both the show and their relationship are threatened, however, when one of Gantry's ex-lovers (Shirley Jones) decides that she has a score to settle with the charismatic performer.

rating.system: Instituto de Cinematografía y de las Artes Visuales

programme.title: The Train
programme.desc: With the Allies poised to retake Paris from the Germans, Col. Franz Von Waldheim (Paul Scofield) conspires to sneak out by train all the art masterpieces looted by the German army. But museum curator Mademoiselle Villard (Suzanne Flon) alerts the French Resistance, and soon railway inspector Paul Labiche (Burt Lancaster) is pressed into service. He reroutes the train, and cleverly deceives Von Waldheim by renaming each train station along the way.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação
Dirección General de Radio, Televisión y Cinematografía

programme.title: The Gypsy Moths
programme.desc: Three men who work in a skydiving performance group -- burned-out Mike (Burt Lancaster), outgoing showman Joe (Gene Hackman) and rookie Malcolm (Scott Wilson) -- find work in a small Kansas town and lodging at the home of Malcolm's Uncle John (William Windom) and Aunt Elizabeth (Deborah Kerr). The couple are in the midst of a marital crisis, and when Elizabeth meets the dashing Mike, everyone is surprised by their passionate and dangerous love affair.

programme.title: Princess O'Rourke
programme.desc: Princess Maria (Olivia de Havilland) and her uncle (Charles Coburn) are in Washington, D.C., where it is hoped she will meet a suitable man to marry. After a number of misfires on the romance front, Maria flies to San Francisco, sedating herself beforehand to combat her fear of flying. Still asleep when the plane sets down, Maria is taken in by the pilot, Eddie (Robert Cummings). When Maria wakes up and meets Edward, sparks fly -- but her royal lineage could complicate matters.

programme.title: Marie Antoinette
programme.desc: The young Austrian princess Marie Antoinette (Norma Shearer) is arranged to marry Louis XVI (Robert Morley), future king of France, in a politically advantageous marriage for the rival countries. The opulent Marie indulges in various whims and flirtations, including Count Axel (Tyrone Power). When Louis XV (John Barrymore) passes and Louis XVI ascends the French throne, his queen's extravagant lifestyle earns the hatred of the French people, who despise her Austrian heritage.

programme.title: The Swan
programme.desc: Prince Albert, who is scouring Europe for a wife, arrives in a tiny town to visit a banished family of nobles. Their matriarch, Beatrix, wants her daughter, Alexandra, to marry Albert so that her family will be welcomed back into the kingdom. In order to rouse Albert's attention, Alexandra flirts with her attractive tutor, Dr. Agi; however, Alexandra's plan hits a snag when she develops genuine feelings for Dr. Agi.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Her Highness and the Bellboy
programme.desc: A New York hotel bellboy (Robert Walker) forgets his girlfriend (June Allyson) after meeting a European princess (Hedy Lamarr).

programme.title: The Glass Slipper
programme.desc: In a retelling of the "Cinderella" tale, young orphan Ella (Leslie Caron) lives with her unpleasant stepmother (Elsa Lanchester) and stepsisters (Amanda Blake, Lisa Daniels), essentially working as their housekeeper. When the local prince (Michael Wilding) returns from school, a ball is announced. Around that time, Ella meets the prince, who is disguised as the son of the palace chef, and the two fall in love. When she manages to attend the ball, his revealed identity causes quite a stir.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Manuela Alva is unhappily engaged to Don Pedro, the mayor of her town. When a circus arrives, she's enchanted by performer Serafin, who's likewise smitten with her. The mayor tries to evict the circus from town, but Serafin turns the tables after realizing Don Pedro is Macoco, an ex-pirate in hiding. When Serafin learns that Manuela dreams of Macoco, he adopts the discarded identity to woo her — but is then condemned to death for the pirate's crimes.

programme.title: The Prisoner of Zenda
programme.desc: This adventure-filled drama finds Englishman Rudolf Rassendyll (Ronald Colman) on vacation in a small European country, where he discovers his resemblance to the nation's royal heir-apparent, Rudolf V. When the king-to-be is drugged and incapacitated, Rassendyll must impersonate him, so that the scheming Duke Michael (Raymond Massey) can't assume the throne. To further complicate matters, Rassendyll starts to fall for Rudolf V's intended bride, Flavia (Madeleine Carroll).

programme.desc: Migration, travel and trade are all key components of human life.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering
programme.desc: As the battle distance continues to grow with each new weapon, humans put their best minds to work refining and evolving their designs over the millennia to gain the upper hand.

programme.title: Earth: The Nature of Our Planet
programme.desc: A miraculous mantle envelops the entire planet - a thin skin of gasses called 'air'. Without it, there would be no life or weather, no habitable conditions, or protection from lethal ultraviolet radiation or meteorites from outer space.

programme.title: Earth: The Nature of Our Planet
programme.desc: It's the solid crust of our planet, the perfect element in which to record the stories of deep time and of lifetimes. Change and progression is the way of earth. Air and water turn solid rock into soil.

programme.title: Earth: The Nature of Our Planet
programme.desc: How the flow of water has the power to shape all inhabitants on Earth, produces climate-changing weather and supporting species, from the largest whales to microscopic plankton.

programme.title: Wild Kingdoms
programme.desc: Rivers are the life veins of this planet, offering all those that depend on them respite from both heat and thirst; a look into how for the life they give, they also take away.

programme.title: Wild Kingdoms
programme.desc: Africa's rainforests are second only to the Amazon in size; see these tangled worlds, that are home to chimpanzees, gorillas and forest elephants, one of the last remaining strongholds for the planet's wild creatures.

programme.title: Zwischen Tüll und Tränen

Die Bandbreite an Modellen überfordert die angehenden Bräute jedoch oft und schnell kann es dann auch mal emotional werden – schließlich ist die Entscheidung eine sehr besondere. programme.title: First Dates – Ein Tisch für zwei
programme.desc: Starkoch Trettl („The Taste“-Juror von 2016 bis 2018) begrüßt die einsamen Herzen, die vorab anhand von Vorlieben und Abneigungen ausgewählt wurden, dann zieht er sich zurück und beobachtet, ob sich die Paare zwischen Salat und Dessert näherkommen. Nach dem Menü stellt sich die Frage: Gibt es ein weiteres Date?

programme.title: Das perfekte Dinner

programme.title: Guidos Deko Queen – Die Challenge

programme.title: Hot oder Schrott – Die Allestester
programme.desc: Erfindungen, die die Welt nicht braucht, werden bei "Hot oder Schrott" auf den Prüfstand gestellt. Die Allestester unterziehen nützliche und skurrile Artikel dem Praxistest. Ob Studenten, Familien oder Senioren – sie testen die Produkte aus aller Welt auf ihre Alltagstauglichkeit (meist niedrig) und ihren Fun-Faktor (meist hoch).

Могъщите реки S1 E3 Яндзъ, най-голямата река в Азия, някога е била дом на редки водни бозайници и изобилни количества риба. Джереми минава през Шанхай, Трите клисури и върховете на Юннан.

Живот при температури под нулата S5 E3 Жителите на Аляска се затрудняват със задачите си. Ниските температури и дебелият лед затрудняват Глен и Анди при лова с капани. Състезанието с впрегатни кучета на Джеси е усложнено от снеговалеж.
Дивата Нова Зеландия S1 E2 Вижте природната красота на Нова Зеландия от Фиордланд - дом на хобитите, до нос Рейнга - северния край, където диви коне тичат по самотни пясъчни плажове.

Скритият вулкан: Изригване от ада На 15 януари 2022 г. вулканът Хунга Тонга - Хунга Хаапай изригна с мощност, равностойна на над 60 милиона тона тротил. Каква е причината за такова изключително мощно изригване на този вулкан?
Най-смъртоносните природни явления в света S2 E12 Ирма, ураган от пета категория, опустошава Карибите. На Фиджи болногледач се бори с катастрофално наводнение, за да стигне до деца в сиропиталище.

Могъщите реки S1 E5 Могъщата американска река Мисисипи е в опасност от извънземни нашественици, токсично замърсяване и нанесени от хората поражения. Джереми се запознава с американци, които искат да решат проблемите.

Лице в лице S1 E1 Акулите се смятат за океански убийци, но дали са такива? Родолф Гиняр се гмурка с тях във Флорида и Бахамите, открива изненадващи взаимодействия и задава въпрос дали е възможно съвместно съществуване.
Кораловият град S1 E2 С настъпването на лятото огромни морски охлюви се опитват да отблъснат нахлуваща банда от гладни за корали морски звезди и други същества.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave and Kevin, who have been an absolute treat for automotive enthusiasts for years, come back to the SEMA show with something special on their minds.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: A Beatles fanatic challenges Dave to paint a modern Rolls-Royce to match the car John Lennon commissioned in the late 1960s.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides

programme.title: Gilmore Girls

programme.title: Desperate Housewives
programme.desc: Gaby (Eva Longoria Parker) und Neu-Nachbarin Renee sind sich sehr ähnlich: hübsch und redselig. programme.title: Desperate Housewives

programme.title: Gilmore Girls

programme.title: Gilmore Girls

programme.title: Gilmore Girls

programme.title: Grey's Anatomy – Die jungen Ärzte
